event.title: Seven Ethiopian Rebel Groups Unite in New Alliance Against Government
event.canonical_title: Seven Ethiopian Rebel Groups Unite in New Alliance Against Government
event.summary: Seven armed groups in Ethiopia have formed a new alliance aimed at opposing the federal government. This coalition includes factions that have been active in the country's most populous regions for several years. An official from the Tigray People's Liberation Front confirmed the formation of this anti-government alliance.

timeline.title: Ethiopian Government-Linked Forces Claim Control in Tigray Amid Escalating Conflict
timeline.summary: An Ethiopian government-aligned group has claimed it is close to achieving full control of the Tigray region. This announcement comes as violence intensifies in northern Ethiopia, exacerbating the already dire diplomatic and humanitarian situations. Concurrently, Ethiopia and Eritrea have severed diplomatic ties as the conflict escalates, with Ethiopian forces engaged in battles against rebel fighters in the area.
key_facts: Ethiopian government-aligned group claims near full control of Tigray region.
Violence is increasing in northern Ethiopia.
Ethiopia and Eritrea have cut diplomatic ties amid the conflict.
